cells.speakerNotes: Title. Your Dashboard Is Too Late: The Great Lunch Incident.
Monday 18 May. Coffee machine Marketing vs Finance email. Both right about the same weekend.
Culprit 1: Finance dashboard: profit and margin down. No campaign context.
Beat. Ask the room: What is a metric?
Culprit 2a: Traditional KPI: profit_margin = profit / revenue.
Culprit 2b: The whole Pydantic object, live.
WHEN to alert. Live: swap the detector and watch KPIs recolour.
WHAT to alert on. Walk dependencies until anomalies stop.
Network graph. Path lands on Baskets EUR20-24.99.
Business resolution. Page Promotions about the basket mix, not Finance about profit.
HOW OFTEN to alert. StatePolicy + evolve_state.
Alerts timeline. Naive flood vs one smart page to Promotions Friday 13:00.
Architecture. Warehouse to semantics (Pydantic KPIDefinition) to graph to detector to state to one incident.
Close + counterfactual. Promotions paged Friday; coffee machine Monday.
Don't make the LLM understand your business. Make your business understandable to people, software, and whatever we build next.
Final beat. Your dashboard isn't bad. It's just too late.
